audience: small teams that send email campaigns and SMS from an Emailchef account

useCases.title: Count the active contacts in each list
useCases.text: List your contact lists with the counts of active, unsubscribed and bounced contacts. Open one list to see its growth by day.

useCases.title: Review how last month's campaigns performed
useCases.text: List the campaigns you sent. Read the links in one campaign and the engagement of its recipients to see who opened and clicked.

useCases.title: Add a new subscriber to a list
useCases.text: Create a contact from the details of a new lead and add it to your Newsletter list. Update the contact later when its details change.

useCases.title: Copy a draft campaign and schedule it
useCases.text: Clone an existing draft campaign into a new draft. Read the timezones and the verified senders, then schedule the new draft for a day and time.

useCases.title: Check sending limits before a big send
useCases.text: Read the send limits and the credits left of the account. Check the SMS balance before you plan a text message to your customers.
